ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) regions occupy the central portion of both lobes, bifurcated by a low-intensity (black) central keel area. Dark pixel mottling and vertical striations are dense within the high-intensity regions, particularly on the trailing edge and medial area of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15 percent of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged, high-amplitude peaks located at the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary trailing edge boundary, transitioning to a sharp upward concave sweep towards the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white and gray pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered smaller circular scars on the black border regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical white linear mark at the mid-left transition from black to white. Multiple parallel dark linear streaks oriented vertically across the right lobe white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large calcified masses on distal tips; potential soft-tissue lesions or parasitic growths visible as small fleshy protrusions hanging from the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive irregular black spotting and a cluster of dark focal spots located in the lower-central region of the right lobe white pigmentation field.
